headline: Copa Airlines Adds Eighth Daily Flight Between Lima and Panama City
summary: Copa Airlines will temporarily increase its operations between Lima and Panama City by adding an eighth daily frequency from December 17, 2026, to January 31, 2027, to meet seasonal travel demand.
why: Capacity expansions on key international routes during peak holiday periods directly influence airline passenger revenues and regional tourism flows.

impacts.name: Copa Holdings
impacts.why: Adding flight frequencies during peak season drives higher passenger volume and operational revenue.
